definitions.auc: auc_json_mean: P1-D's auc.json (every known payload unit, mean over 3 seeds); foreground / seed host: AUC of the U3 utility (= P_mal + 1) among the IoT-23 foreground / the seed host's known payload units
definitions.control: group in_domain_orig of E3_numbers_rev1_zq.json: the original streams re-run with the code of the variant run (must equal the original numbers)
definitions.e3_vs_U0: the relmse statistic with the uniform design U0 as reference instead of U1 (U1 = size-only moves with the committed floor phi0, which the scans' bytes inflate in the original recipe): per scenario sum_q MSE_d/Q^2 / sum_q Var_U0/Q^2 over the design's estimands, GM + the aggregator's cluster bootstrap
definitions.ks: two-sample KS statistic of the seed host's payload-unit rolling features, original vs variant stream (same units)
definitions.relmse_ratio: as E3_numbers.json: per scenario sum_q Var_d/Q^2 / sum_q Var_U1/Q^2 over classes D+S, Q > 0; GM over the 6 scenarios with the aggregator's cluster bootstrap (2,000 resamples, estimands nested)
definitions.seed_vs_background_auc: AUC of one rolling feature separating the seed host's payload units from the CIC background's (0.5 = not identifiable by that feature alone)
definitions.statements: n_below_U1 = scenarios with ratio < 1; ratio_vs_orig = variant / original per scenario; sign_test_p_worse = exact one-sided binomial P(X >= #worse | n = #non-identical, 1/2)

variants.z0: scan-free bound: every pure zero-payload connection of the seed host removed (training LP streams likewise; model training sources: each IoT-23 malware scenario's seed host likewise; models retrained)
variants.zq: original recipe + the seed (infected) host's pure zero-payload connections kept with the stream's payload keep probability q (independent child seed stream; payload decisions bit-identical); training LP streams and model training sources by the same rule
